note: Rough-draft preview text (brief preview-and-lookup-10-24, section 4; wording approved by the owner in the C04 final wording review, 11/13/2026). Shown under the real room headings in the free preview so the agent sees what each section will say, in place of filler. Says 'we' or 'our writer', never 'AI'. 'rooms' holds three lines per room group (R01-R11); 'roomGroups' maps each photo's room type to its group. The lines rotate across the whole package, so two pieces never open a section with the same line, and a line is reused only after its group runs out. The preview joins and trims them to each slot's real copy length. No model call. Never on a paid or downloaded piece: the templates' checks and the download guard block any render that carries preview text. Wording is the owner's call; edit here only. 'fillers' (R12) are the add-on lines used only to top up a long slot's last line in the preview.
